title: Pepperoni Pizza Pasta Bake
subtitle: rotini and seasoned beef in marinara under bubbling mozzarella and crisp pepperoni: pizza night in a 9×13
imageAlt: A baking dish of rotini in tomato sauce topped with melted mozzarella and crisp pepperoni, a scoop on a cream plate with a navy napkin
servingsNote: a 9×13 pan: dinner for two, plus 4 lunches

beforeYouStart.text: Undercook the rotini by 2 minutes; it finishes in the oven.

steps.title: Water on
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Bring a big pot of water to a boil with the salt.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.text: Cook the beef and onion in a large deep skillet over medium-high, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes, until no pink remains and it reads 71°C (160°F). Spoon off the fat.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Stir in the marinara, tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, garlic powder and salt and simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Meanwhile, cook the rotini 2 minutes less than the package says and drain. Stir it into the sauce.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Spread it in a 23×33 cm (9×13 in) baking dish. Scatter the mozzarella and Parmesan over, then lay the pepperoni on top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake uncovered 18–20 minutes, until bubbling, the pepperoni crisps at the edges and the centre reads 74°C (165°F). Rest 5 minutes.

fixIt.fix: It was cooked too long first or baked too long; add ½ cup water or extra sauce next time.
Lay it on for the last 10 minutes only.
Blot the pepperoni pools with paper towel; drain the beef well next time.

saleTip: Marinara jars are often 2 for $5 at No Frills; ground beef family packs are cheapest per kilo.
swap: Penne or rigatoni for rotini. Mild Italian sausage meat for the beef, cooked to 71°C (160°F).
leftovers: Cut into squares once cold; they reheat neatly.
doneness: Ground beef to 71°C (160°F) with no pink (Health Canada, ground beef); bake until the centre reads 74°C (165°F).
source: Based on tested pizza pasta bake methods (Canadian Living, Food Network Canada): par-cooked short pasta in a beef marinara, topped with mozzarella and pepperoni, baked uncovered at 200°C.
prepAhead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead without the pepperoni; bake from cold 30–35 minutes covered, then 10 uncovered with the pepperoni, until 74°C (165°F).
Freeze unbaked up to 3 months; thaw overnight in the fridge first.
reheat: Covered in the microwave 2–3 minutes, or covered at 180°C (350°F) for 20 minutes, until 74°C (165°F).

basic.note: Beef and rotini in marinara under mozzarella; no pepperoni or onion.

fancy.note: Crispy bacon and extra pepperoni, the 'meat lovers' way.

stepNotes.4: Fancy: scatter the bacon over the cheese and add the extra pepperoni.

plating: Cut a neat square and lift it with a spatula.

why.1-3: Canned tomato sauce adds extra saucy body so the pasta doesn't dry out in the oven.
why.2-1: Pepperoni cups and crisps on top, just like on a pizza.
why.0-0: Rotini's spirals trap the meat sauce.

funFact: Pepperoni is the most popular pizza topping in Canada and the United States.
